rationale: FX03 flags cost_currency value U_USD as non-USD, but the raw Schedule of Investments presents the relevant amortized cost and fair value columns in dollars. Table 43 row 1 labels Amortized Cost and Fair Value, and row 5 shows dollar signs directly before the cost and fair value amounts. The source therefore supports USD denomination; the flag is due to treating the internal U_USD unit label as non-USD rather than a source data error.
